products.desc:

products.name: X Stand Banners
products.desc:
1. Affordable one-time investment with easily interchangeable banners for repeated use.

products.name: A-Frame Signs
products.desc:
Custom A-frame signs boost storefront and event visibility with single or double-sided options.
Select lightweight metal or heavy-duty frames, customizable with custom art or templates.
Add accessories like carrying cases and solar lights for durable, all-weather promotion.
